snippet.title: The Poveglia Demo now available!
snippet.description:
The Poveglia demo is here!
Venture into the terrifying island of Poveglia and experience the first moments of this horror story.  Demo now available! https://store.steampowered.com/app/4037640/Poveglia_The_Island_of_Non_Return_Demo/
 
Join our Discord to see more about the game developing: https://www.discord.gg/hMewakCaFa
